purpose: Conservative public surface-point AUX label prototype, not native gold and not a model fit.
basis: Explicit user authorization of open real data; first public unoccluded geometry metrology only, no current/held/SourceDEV model scores. Frozen before decoding second occluded pilot.
pose_interpretation: T object-to-camera as publisher 3D-model description; inverse also retained in geometry report. No optimization or bias correction.

label_definition.D: Full11x11 valid observed/render support and stable depth windows, full11x11 SAM target support, abs(center observed-render)<=0.05m.
label_definition.E: Same stable valid depth/render windows, full11x11 SAM background, center observed-render<=-0.15m.
label_definition.U: Everything else, with exclusion reasons; not a correct model abstention.
label_definition.SELF: Not inferred from mask-negative. These reference samples use the front rendered target surface, not hidden mesh vertices.
label_definition.r_vs_q: Label at reference r and SAM presence at emulated q must be stored separately. q offsets are public emulation, not fresh v61/initializer inference. No relabeling of r D/E as query-pixel gold.
label_definition.native: Generic surfaceAUX, no new eight-slot native gold or physical native-support requirement.
